# Getinge hintar om starkare tillväxt – Handelsbanken får minskat kapitalkrav

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an EFN Morgon earnings-special episode with fund manager Anders Bruzelius (Tellus fonder), EFN analyst Ture Wester, and CEO interviews from SKF, Husqvarna, Mips and Dynavox. Husqvarna's historic Q3 loss stood out as the clear loser of the day. SKF was in line, with focus on the upcoming Vertevo automotive spin-off. Mips, Getinge, Inwido and Dynavox looked solid, and Handelsbanken's lower capital requirement was welcomed. The market mood was described as nervous but improving on AI-related reports and SpaceX.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Historic Q3 loss, savings eaten by inflation, weak EU consumer, Chinese competition, high dealer stocks; hosts call it the day's loser.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bruzelius finds it hard to see a turn unless the consumer comes back, and calls 2027 challenging at least at the start. Remaining cost savings and price increases may help, and 0.45x sales is cheap, but the near-term picture is poor. The panel called it clearly worse than other reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- European consumer demand recovers
- cost savings reach the bottom line
- margin recovers in Q4/2027

> *"Ja det är svårt att se hur det här ska vända såvida inte konsumenten kommer tillbaka ordentligt."*

---

### 🔴 SKF-B — SKF | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Result slightly below expectations; Bruzelius expects the shares to fall. HB analyst Engellau expects a flat reaction.

#### Reasoning

Bruzelius (guest) thinks engineering companies that don't beat expectations will struggle, and that SKF will fall. Ture notes four straight post-report share declines. Cited analyst Engellau sees the numbers spot on and expects flat. Long term, the industrial unit could re-rate after the Vertevo spin-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- broader industrial upturn lifts volumes
- industrial unit re-rated after spin-off

> *"så jag tror att den här aktien kommer att sjunka"*

---

### 🟢 MIPS — Mips | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

24% organic growth, margin 45% heading to 50%, fast-growing safety segment, 2029 targets on track; Ture favours the stock.

#### Reasoning

Hosts and guest called the report strong but in line with high expectations. CEO targets >30% organic growth and safety at 25% of sales by 2029. Brand-based moat beyond the 2030-31 patent expiries. Ture is said to have a soft spot for Mips.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth stays below 30%
- loss of brand preference after patent expiry
- margin stalls

> *"Den såg rätt stark ut, även om den var ungefär i linje med förväntningarna, som ju är högt ställda får man säga."*

---

### 🟢 INWI — Inwido | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Beat on sales and earnings, 5% organic growth, acquisitions resumed; Ture expects a positive share reaction.

#### Reasoning

Analyst Ture sees a strong report following a strong prior quarter, with margins up and acquisitions restarting. He expects a positive share reaction today.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth fades
- margins fall back

> *"så det tror jag kan bli en positiv kursreaktion där"*

---

### ⛔ SECARE — Sweden Care | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Earnings well below expectations; shares typically move a lot on report day.

#### Reasoning

A panelist expects a negative reaction after a clear earnings miss.

#### Sell Triggers

- earnings recover next quarter

> *"Den brukar också röra sig ganska mycket på rapportdagen så den kan nog. får sig en släng av sleven också."*

---

### 🟡 GETI-B — Getinge | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Margin beat again, back on the growth track with cost control; soft top line and shares already up strongly since Q2.

#### Reasoning

Bruzelius sees Getinge through its problems with good cost control, plus currency help in Q4. But organic growth is a bit below guidance and the shares have already re-rated, so the view is positive without being a clear buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth misses the 3-5% guidance
- Acute Care Therapies margin reverses

> *"De har haft sina problem men det känns som de är igenom det här och är tillbaka på tillväxtbanan"*

---

### 🟡 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Report in line; SEK 3bn lower capital requirement makes the dividend safer and allows buybacks.

#### Reasoning

Bruzelius calls the capital news good: dividends become safer this year and next, and buybacks become possible. Low credit losses supported the result. This is income support rather than a growth catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit losses rise
- capital requirements tighten again

> *"Utdelningen blir väl mer trygg då, och även nästa år."*

---

### 🟠 NFLX — Netflix | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Soft guidance and weak ad monetisation, but valuation at interesting levels.

#### Reasoning

A panelist sees no short-term catalyst but finds the valuation attractive and says to keep an eye on it.

#### Sell Triggers

- ad revenue keeps disappointing

> *"Däremot så är det nere på rätt intressanta nivåer värderingsmässigt. Det gäller att hålla lite koll på den."*

---
